prospective_projection.calibration: Multiply all ANOVA-normal projected widths by registered_v3_percentile_width / ANOVA-normal_width_at_S8_Q20 so the projection exactly recovers the observed V3 width at its base design.
prospective_projection.required_pair_formula: Smallest integer Q whose calibrated projected interval width is <= 2.0 pp; report impossible when the seed variance floor already exceeds the target.

two_way_random_effects.negative_component_handling: truncate seed and pair method-of-moments components at zero
two_way_random_effects.observation: mean exposure effect over the two members for each model-seed by pattern-pair cell

algorithm: Group all 320 frozen eligible semantic IDs by target relation.
Sort semantic IDs within relation and pair adjacent IDs without reuse.
Sort all pairs by SHA-256(member_0 + member_1).
Remove the exact 20 pair hashes used by V3.
Count the remaining disjoint pairs globally and by relation.
v4_capacity.strict_design_gate: Pass only if remaining disjoint pair capacity is at least the projected pair requirement at infinite seeds and the calibrated projected width using all remaining pairs at infinite seeds is <= 2.0 pp.

variance_decomposition.group_draw_sharing: Within a replicate, source-group draws are shared over selected model seeds and exposed/unexposed arms; pair members receive independent draws.
variance_decomposition.shapley: Average each factor's marginal increase in bootstrap variance over all 3! factor-entry permutations.
